g.text: SELECT ... FROM products WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
Soft deactivation only: the row and all its relationships (category, allergens,
component type, BCK08 configurations, BCK10 pizzas, BCK09 stock record) are preserved (AC 9 / AC 10).
isStockControlled and the stock quantity are NOT changed and BCK09 is NOT called.
PATCH /api/v1/products/:id/activate follows the same flow calling product.activate() and returns 200 OK.
